name: Question 5
worked_solution:
We distribute the conjunction over the disjunction, as follows:

$$
(¬P∨R)∧Q≡(¬P∧Q)∨(R∧Q)
$$

Question 5
?

Which statement is equivalent to (¬P∨R)∧Q?

a
(¬P∧Q)∨(R∧Q)
b
(R∧Q)∧¬P
c
(¬P∧Q)∨(¬P∧R)
d
¬P∧(Q∨R)
e
(¬P∧Q)∧(R∧Q)
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We distribute the conjunction over the disjunction, as follows:

(¬P∨R)∧Q≡(¬P∧Q)∨(R∧Q)
